title: Serverware native proof-client principal preflight configuration v3
description: Closed independently pinned configuration original, at most 16384 bytes. Opts into genuine principal preflight on the actual outer TLS connection before CONNECT. Shape is not a quote verdict, independently established pin provenance, CA installation permission, provider-request authorization or production acceptance. V1 and v2 remain separate closed profiles and cannot select these additional fields or silently fall back.

startupEvidence.description: Held serverware.nativeIngressPublicEvidence/v1 startup original, at most 65536 bytes; genuine still-fresh verification precedes the outer client private key.

startupExpectations.description: Held serverware.nativeIngressAttestationExpectations/v1 original, at most 16384 bytes, independently binding complete startup scope and nonce.

sessionScope.description: Held nonce-free serverware.nativeIngressSessionScope/v1 original, at most 16384 bytes. Its static scope must match startup; the client owns one newly generated challenge for the live session.

trustRoots.description: Held independent native Nitro PKI trust-root original, at most 1048576 bytes; distinct from outer TLS roots and workload issuer trust.

workloadIssuer.description: Held canonical single-certificate PEM, at most 65536 bytes and DER at most 16384 bytes. Fresh evidence must authenticate its unique membership in the actual native framed-DER inventory and verify the public client chain actually selected by this TLS handshake under only that anchor. No installation receipt or copied diagnostic substitutes for these originals.

expectedPrincipal.description: Independent expected policy principal, exactly equal to --expected-principal-id. Runtime additionally limits UTF-8 bytes to 1024 and rejects leading/trailing Unicode whitespace and control characters. This v3 preflight limit does not widen legacy provider-response proof profiles.

expectedIdentityPolicySha256.description: Independent exact commitment to the principal's complete current identity policy. It is not a bearer credential, selector summary, provider route permission or canary result.
